question: Should `agent-job.ts` become the permanent single owner of Gateway terminal run state and `agent.wait` resolution?
rationale: Source review establishes that the repaired implementation is coherent, but the protected `maintainer` label and linked ownership proposal reserve this durable Gateway boundary for explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the single registry
options.body: Approve the consolidated owner because it removes the competing waiter state machine while preserving current collision and terminal-precedence behavior.

options.title: Retain split ownership
options.body: Keep lifecycle and dedupe waiter ownership separate if maintainers prefer the existing boundary despite its duplicated reconciliation logic.

recommendation.title: Adopt the single registry
